description: This file defines the ReturnAction controller class within the Opencart administration module, handling CRUD operations and view rendering for return actions in the localisation section.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Controller class for managing return actions within the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the main return action page, including breadcrumbs, page title, and view loading.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of return actions by calling getList() and rendering the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of return actions, including pagination and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return action, including loading related languages and returning existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated return actions, performing permission checks, validation, and database updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions after permission check and ensures they are not linked to existing returns.
